headline: Weekly Briefing: Digital Product Passports, CSRD, and Green Claims Enforcement
summary: This week saw technical progress on Digital Product Passport standards under ESPR, alongside regulatory pressure on CSRD reporting for listed mid-caps. EU authorities also stepped up enforcement against unverified environmental claims, impacting consumer product marketing across your European distribution channels.

items.title: Two new EU standards issued for Digital Product Passports
items.what: Two new EU standards have been developed for data security and access control in Digital Product Passports under the Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation.
items.meaning: Directly relevant for your power tools and battery platform as technical data access and security architecture for DPPs is finalised.
items.action: Review the data security standards with your IT and product compliance teams.

sources.title: Digital Product Passport: Two New EU Standards for Data Security and Access Control

items.title: CSRD compliance urged for listed mid-caps as EFRAG consults
items.what: Spanish securities regulators urged listed firms with over 1,000 employees to align disclosures with CSRD, as EFRAG opened a consultation on its 2027–2029 agenda.
items.meaning: Reinforces enforcement expectations for listed companies in your size bracket ahead of mandatory 2027 reporting.
items.action: Maintain preparation for 2027 reporting and evaluate EFRAG's agenda consultation.

sources.title: The CNMV urges listed companies with more than 1,000 employees to align their sustainability reports with the CSRD.
EU CSRD: EFRAG launched consultation on its 2027–2029 sustainability reporting agenda, Julia Voskoboinikova

items.title: EU Commission enforces stricter standards on consumer green claims
items.what: The European Commission secured commitments from major consumer brands to correct misleading recycling claims, alongside new ESMA guidance on sustainability marketing.
items.meaning: Signals active regulatory scrutiny of environmental claims on consumer products, packaging, and battery sustainability.
items.action: Audit product packaging and consumer marketing claims across EU markets.

sources.title: EU Commission secures recycling claim changes from Coca-Cola, Nestlé and Danone
ESMA Guidance on Impact and Climate Transition Claims
